title: Rory and the Sleepy Starflower Hill
verses:
The sun had dipped beneath the crest,
The sleepy shadows softly grew,
And Rory ambled toward his rest,
Across a field of misty blue.

Above the trees did Nia glide,
To guide them through the fading light,
While Ricky scampered by her side,
Then slowed his feet to greet the night.

Then Tilly strolled with steady grace,
Where fallen petals softly lay,
And Benny found a mossy place,
To watch the colors fade away.

Then Psittaco began to sing,
A gentle tune to calm the deep,
While Rory made a leafy ring,
Where every friend could drift to sleep.

The clover made a velvet bed,
The summer breeze was sweet and low,
And Rory rested down his head,
Amid the sleepy, silver glow.

The glowing stars began to gleam,
Across the meadow wide and still,
While Rory shared a peaceful dream,
Upon the quiet, sleepy hill.
